notes: Measured baseline for scripts/resource-metrics.py on ubuntu-latest. Recorded from the `resource-metrics` artifact of the first green Resource Metrics run (run 41773725479, release build, 60 s idle, 60 preview frames of scripts/ci-resource-metrics/preview.toml) after the report grew the `sampler` liveness evidence. Update it with a deliberate --write-baseline run and commit the diff with the reason; CI never writes it.
